HelpModal.title: How to play
HelpModal.description: Guess the hidden 5-letter word in 6 tries. After each guess, the colors point you in the right direction so you can narrow it down fast.
HelpModal.seoDescription: Learn how Wordle works, what each tile color means, and how to read a guess with a real example.

basics.guess: Guess the hidden 5-letter word before you run out of tries.
basics.submit: Each guess has to be a real word. Type it in and hit Enter to lock it in.
basics.clues: After every guess, the tiles change color to show how close you are.

correct.title: Green
correct.exampleCaption: W is in the word and locked in place.

present.title: Yellow
present.exampleCaption: I is in the word, but not there.

absent.title: Gray
absent.description: That letter is not in the word.
absent.exampleCaption: U is not in the answer.

walkthroughPoints.two: R is in. Move it too.

HelpModal.walkthroughSummary: Keep C, R, A, and E. Drop N.
HelpModal.repeatsIntro: Gray does not always mean never. Sometimes it means too many.
HelpModal.repeatsSummary: APPLE has one L. The first L scores. The second one can miss.

tips.duplicates: Some answers use the same letter more than once, so don't rule out repeats too early.
tips.keyboard: The keyboard uses the same colors, so you can keep track of what you've learned at a glance.
tips.strategy: A strong opening word usually gives you more useful information if it mixes common vowels and consonants.

StackdownHelp.title: How to play
StackdownHelp.description: Clear a stack of letter tiles by finding all 6 hidden words. Fewer hints, more stars.
StackdownHelp.seoDescription: Learn how Stackdown works: pick exposed tiles to spell each hidden 5-letter word, spend hints wisely to keep your stars, and race the optional timer.
StackdownHelp.goal: Thirty letter tiles. Six hidden five-letter words. Find them all and the stack is gone — that's the whole game.

basics.pick: Tap a bright tile to pick it. Bright means nothing is sitting on top — dimmed tiles are buried for now.
basics.slot: Your tile pops into a slot up top, and lifting it might uncover fresh letters in the stack.
basics.submit: Fill all five slots and the word submits itself. Nail it and those tiles are gone for good.
basics.invalid: Spelled something that isn't the word? The tiles shake it off and slide right back into the stack. No harm done.
basics.undo: Changed your mind? Tap a letter in the slots to send it back — everything you picked after it goes too.

stack.exposedCaption: Nothing covers it, so it's yours for the taking.
stack.coveredCaption: Another tile sits on top. Clear the ones above to free it.

StackdownHelp.oneWord: At any moment, the word you're hunting can be spelled from the exposed letters — really, we promise it's in there. You might spot other words in the pile, but only that one clears tiles. If the stack looks impossible, look again.

hints.slider: Stuck? Choose Need a hint? below the stack, then swipe to reveal a clue for the word you're hunting — one per word.
hints.stars: You start every game with 6 stars, and each hint costs one. Clear the stack hint-free for a perfect run.
hints.floor: Finishing always earns at least 1 star — but the bragging rights live at 6.

timer.runs: The clock starts when the puzzle loads and pauses itself whenever you leave the tab.
timer.hidden: It's hidden by default so the game stays chill. Tap the clock icon if you like the pressure.
timer.score: Time never touches your stars — those are all about hints. Finish a stack and you'll get a timecard for each word, plus your best time ever.

tips.whichTile: Two tiles can show the same letter but hide different things underneath — which one you pick matters.
tips.daily: A fresh stack drops every day, and practice mode deals a random one whenever you want.
tips.leaderboard: The leaderboard ranks by stars first, then by fastest clear.
